title: What support does Pinnacle Blooms provide to parents for at-home Speech Therapy?
metaTitle: At-Home Speech Therapy Support from Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the guidance and at-home speech therapy resources provided to parents by Pinnacle Blooms Network to help enhance children's learning journey.
html: Indeed, we believe parents are the backbone of their child's progress. Our therapists equip parents with guidance and resources that help reinforce therapy impact right at home, ensuring learning doesn't stop once therapy sessions are over. This could be in the form of activities that encourage play-based learning or practical advice for everyday interactions. We encourage and maintain continuous parent-therapist communication for updates, guidance, and strengthening the bridge of progress between our centers and your home.
